notes: The central highland dialects of north Yemen, mapped by Behnstedt's atlas. ATTESTED, NOT YET DESCRIBED HERE. A published description exists and is named in `sources`; its phonology has not been read into this spec. The grapheme table is inherited from the parent and is a placeholder, NOT a claim about this variety — no reflex below has been checked against the source. The entry exists so the lect has a code and resolves to something usable rather than to nothing; `quality` is `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's. Cited by Watson & Asiri (2007) for pre-pausal devoicing.
